brief:
Israeli authorities have issued 9,518 demolition or stop-work notices against Palestinian structures in the occupied West Bank since the start of 2015, Middle East Eye reported. The notices target homes, schools, water systems and other infrastructure across the territory.

The enforcement actions span Area C, the portion of the West Bank under full Israeli administrative and security control, where Palestinian construction is heavily restricted.

title: Israel issues over 9,500 demolition notices in West Bank since 2015
